about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Gilbert Ray Cisneros, Jr.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
statements.title: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
sentences: We should be debating amendments that rein in this administration's reckless conduct on this Iran war or its reckless spending in the Middle East.
The fact is, this amendment restrains the Secretary's ability to allocate security and law enforcement resources to address traffic safety.
Mr. Chair, I rise in opposition to this amendment.
Mr. Chair, I am going to say, I am pretty baffled by this amendment from my friend and colleague, and I rise in opposition to this amendment.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
statements.title: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
sentences: This amendment bans gender-affirming care for servicemembers and their dependents under TRICARE.
Recently, the Secretary of Defense just came out in support of gender-affirming care for our male servicemembers by providing the testosterone testing and treatment for those who need it.

The Secretary is currently kicking out transgender servicemembers, and now this cruel amendment is targeting dependents of servicemembers who are receiving hormone therapy and mental health counseling for gender dysphoria.
Mr. Chair, gender dysphoria is real.
Both in this debate and in the previous debate, my colleagues have said gender dysphoria is a mental health issue, and it needs to be treated.
Mr. Chair, I rise in opposition to the amendment.
Mr. Chair, I rise in strong opposition to this amendment.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MASS SHOOTINGS
statements.title: MASS SHOOTINGS
sentences: We have a problem with gun violence and mass shootings in this country.
The prayers might make us feel good, but they are doing nothing to stop the scourge of gun violence threatening our communities.
There is not going to be a miracle from Heaven that will end gun violence for us.
Over 90 percent of Americans want universal background checks.
Mr. Speaker, 60 percent support an assault weapons ban, 75 percent support red flag laws, and over 83 percent support gun safety storage.
Anyone who does this must have mental health issues.
This is all the more reason for the background checks and the red flag laws.
We have a problem with gun violence and mass shootings in our country, and Congress must finally act.
Will enacting these laws eliminate mass shootings, gun violence, or suicides completely?
No, but commonsense gun laws like this will make a difference, and it is a start.
We also lost a great American and artist in Rob Reiner and his wife, Michele, this past weekend due to an act of violence.
I prayed for them on Sunday, and I will continue to pray for them, but it is not enough.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MADE IN AMERICA MANUFACTURING FINANCE ACT
statements.title: MADE IN AMERICA MANUFACTURING FINANCE ACT
sentences: The small business landscape is littered with obstacles like finding qualified workers, dealing with supply chain disruption as they adjust to the President's tariff regime, and adopting new technologies in order to stay competitive.

Let's all be honest, as a result of the crushing use of tariffs imposed unilaterally by the President, small businesses are clamoring for options in their supply chains that avoid massive and ever-changing taxes at points of entry, but a renewed economic focus on making things in the U.S. cannot happen at the snap of a finger.
I am proud to support them, and I thank my colleagues for the bipartisan effort.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SBA IT MODERNIZATION REPORTING ACT
statements.title: SBA IT MODERNIZATION REPORTING ACT
sentences: I rise today in support of my bill, the SBA IT Modernization Reporting Act, and I thank the chairman for his support.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill to ensure we give the SBA the modern tools it needs to support the success of America's small businesses.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SBA FRAUD ENFORCEMENT EXTENSION ACT
statements.title: SBA FRAUD ENFORCEMENT EXTENSION ACT
sentences: I rise today in support of H.R. 4495, the SBA Fraud Enforcement Extension Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: OFFICE OF RURAL AFFAIRS ENHANCEMENT ACT
statements.title: OFFICE OF RURAL AFFAIRS ENHANCEMENT ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of this commonsense legislation to enhance the Office of Rural Affairs at the SBA.
I will, once again, thank Ms. Goodlander, Mr. Wied, and Mr. Golden for their bipartisan efforts on behalf of America's rural small businesses.
Mr. Speaker, I will, once again, thank my colleagues, Ms. Goodlander, Mr. Wied, and Mr. Golden, for their bipartisan efforts to pass this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: INVESTING IN ALL OF AMERICA ACT OF 2025
statements.title: INVESTING IN ALL OF AMERICA ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 2066, the Investing in All of America Act.

Due to their capital-intensive nature and early revenue profile, these small businesses operating in the critical technology sector need institutional investors with longer term time horizons to raise capital.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: VACCINES PROTECT OUR COMMUNITIES
statements.title: VACCINES PROTECT OUR COMMUNITIES
sentences: Health and Human Services Secretary Kennedy has been on a mission to spread misinformation and fear-mongering to scare parents away from getting their kids lifesaving vaccines.
I urge all Americans to trust our scientists, our doctors, and decades of research.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STREAMLINING PROCUREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
statements.title: STREAMLINING PROCUREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
sentences: Russia, Iran, the People's Republic of China, and other adversaries do.
Madam Chair, I rise in opposition to this amendment.
Madam Chair, I urge my colleagues to vote ``no'' on this amendment.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent to amend the rule to make in order the amendment at the desk that protects against any cuts to Medicaid and SNAP.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DENOUNCING ICE RAIDS IN SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA
statements.title: DENOUNCING ICE RAIDS IN SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA
sentences: Local and State law enforcement did not ask for assistance.
The National Guard is standing on the sidelines, watching as local law enforcement handles the situation.
He wants to create a conflict that will allow him to invoke the Insurrection Act or martial law--God only knows why--but California will never ever bend to the will of a tyrant.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SAVE SBA FROM SANCTUARY CITIES ACT OF 2025
statements.title: SAVE SBA FROM SANCTUARY CITIES ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to oppose this bill and to vote in favor of my motion to recommit.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ENDING PAY-FOR-PLAY POLITICAL GIFTS
statements.title: ENDING PAY-FOR-PLAY POLITICAL GIFTS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, Donald Trump was elected with a mandate to improve the lives of hardworking Americans, to lower housing costs, to make groceries, childcare, and medicine more affordable, and to help our seniors get the care they need.
He has used his position to inflate his own wealth and pad the pocketbooks of billionaire donors, all at the expense of the very people who elected him.
Unlike every single President before him, Donald Trump has refused to divest his business interests.
He didn't even put them in a blind trust.
While House Republicans are out here snatching SNAP benefits away from children, Trump is making sure his billionaire buddies get higher tax breaks.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GULF OF AMERICA ACT
statements.title: GULF OF AMERICA ACT
sentences: They are worried about how they can afford healthcare once these Medicaid cuts take effect.
Seniors are scared their Social Security checks are going to dry up, but Republicans want to focus on renaming a body of water thousands of miles away from where we are today.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: POPE FRANCIS LED BY EXAMPLE
statements.title: POPE FRANCIS LED BY EXAMPLE
sentences: The latest proposal to place so-called per capita caps on Medicaid funding would still jeopardize healthcare for millions of Americans.
I urge my Republican colleagues to stop with their empty platitudes, to stop catering to the cruel authority of President Trump, to stop putting billionaires over the American people.
I urge them to take Pope Francis' message of compassion, of respect, and of moral courage to heart.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DISASTROUS IMPLICATIONS OF A YEARLONG CR
statements.title: DISASTROUS IMPLICATIONS OF A YEARLONG CR
sentences: The Department of Defense would have to slow recruiting efforts and delay servicemember moves, throwing our military families into limbo, not to mention it would potentially negate the 14.5 percent pay raise for junior-enlisted servicemembers, delay military housing projects, and undercut initiatives to improve servicemember quality of life and mental health.

A CR means new weapons programs cannot get started.'' Shipbuilding will be delayed. ``A yearlong CR means we are not serious about building a military that will deter China, Russia, and Iran.'' The White House may be out of touch with reality when it comes to Ukraine and supporting our allies abroad, but their fealty to Vladimir Putin doesn't mean the United States can resign its role in standing for Ukraine and democracies around the world.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SMALL BUSINESS PROCUREMENT AND UTILIZATION REFORM ACT OF 2025
statements.title: SMALL BUSINESS PROCUREMENT AND UTILIZATION REFORM ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of the Small Business Procurement and Utilization Reform, or SPUR, Act.
I urge my colleagues to support this commonsense, bipartisan piece of legislation, and I thank, again, the co-leads of Congressman Stauber and Congresswoman Gluesenkamp Perez.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING DEI
statements.title: SUPPORTING DEI
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I originally came to the floor today because I was dismayed by the President's continued assault on diversity, equity, and inclusion.
The disgusting comments the President made, blaming the tragic crash at Reagan National Airport on DEI, were just the latest example.

Since last Friday, Elon's acolytes, none of whom are government employees and by all appearances have no understanding of how our government even works, have been installed and have taken over at the State Department, the U.S. Treasury, the Office of Personnel Management, the General Services Administration, and the U.S. Agency for International Development.

Without any legal authority, robber baron Elon Musk has embedded himself in our government, unlawfully obtained information that affects millions of Americans, and tasked himself with carrying out President Trump's grievances against his political enemies, not to mention the President has already fired over a dozen January 6 Federal prosecutors, begun to scrutinize the perceived loyalty of thousands of rank-and-file FBI agents, and invalidated the contracts of thousands of government employees.
I plan to do everything I can at every opportunity to call out the President and Elon Musk for what they are doing.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ELECTED WITH A MANDATE
statements.title: ELECTED WITH A MANDATE
sentences: Let's take a moment to highlight what the President has done for the people during his first week in office: ended birthright citizenship, a guaranteed right under the 14th Amendment; terminated diversity, equity, and inclusion programs; withdrew the United States from the Paris agreement; renamed the Gulf of Mexico; raised the cost of prescription drugs for seniors on Medicare and Medicaid; pardoned 1,500 convicted felons who stormed our Capitol and violently assaulted our police officers on January 6, 2021; and created a special fake department for shadow president Elon Musk.
I urge the President to stop treating the White House like his Twitter account and get to work fixing the problems he was elected to solve. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MAJOR DISASTER DECLARATION URGED FOR CALIFORNIA WILDFIRES
statements.title: MAJOR DISASTER DECLARATION URGED FOR CALIFORNIA WILDFIRES
sentences: I am also appalled by the recent calls from the other side to condition aid on a debt limit deal.
I strongly urge House leadership to immediately bring a supplemental spending bill to California's efforts to combat this fire and make Angelenos whole again. ____________________
